notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1. A new feature will be launched soon: automatic sweeping of the Imperial Squad!
2. “Treasure Race” activity will be launched soon, unlocking or upgrading treasure parts can get points reward.
3. Optimize the experience of Expedition.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1.Mid-Autumn Festival activities will be opened soon, claim the surprises everyday.
2.Optimisation of game experience.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Appointment for siege: Lords can make an appointment for siege in advance, and hosting function is provided for those whose time is not suitable.

notes.title: 08/22 update
notes.notes:
1. Some bug fixes and experience optimisation
2. New heroes Temujin and Danni will appear soon.

notes.title: Feb 02 Update
notes.notes:
1.The Spring Festival celebration is approaching. You will be able to drive away the Nian beast, log in to receive Spring Festival bonuses, and join other players in raiding Spring Festival treasure chests. 
2.Valentine's Day celebration events are coming soon! During the festival, log in to receive rewards; have a chance to obtain the limited edition castle skin "Romantic Flower City"; and there's more, "Tiny Angels" await you!
3.Experience optimization has been done for the "Expedition Land" gameplay and "Dawn Drill" event.
4.Added notification for reward changes in the "Empire Pass" event.

notes.title: Dec 20 Update
notes.notes:
The Christmas and New Year's double celebration is about to begin, with surprises every day! 
Participate in the celebration for a chance to obtain limited-time holiday appearances such as Christmas Spirit and Snow Wonderland, and there are also festival login rewards waiting for you to claim! 

In addition, don't miss out on new gameplay activities such as Lucky Lottery Tickets and New Year's Gachapon.

notes.title: Oct. 18th Update
notes.notes:
1.New event "Mysterious Cave" is coming soon, giving you the opportunity to win super lucky grand prizes by exploring the mysterious cave!
2.Partial experience optimization and bug fixes.
